label: SmartTransit IoT Bridge
info:
Bridges Wokwi MQTT sensors into the SmartTransit platform.

Traffic sensors (Albi):
  smarttransit/traffic/gps   → POST /internal/traffic/location
  smarttransit/traffic/speed → (merged with GPS before POST)

Environment sensors (Melva):
  smarttransit/environment/passenger  → POST /internal/environment/passenger
  smarttransit/environment/temperature → POST /internal/environment/temperature
  smarttransit/environment/air         → POST /internal/environment/air
